fixture.name: Day Chart Fixture
fixture.note: Synthetic. Paris, 21 June 1990, midday clock time. Sun in the 10th, well above the horizon: an unambiguous day chart. Anchors the sect unit test. Note clock noon in CEST is ~1.8h before solar noon, so the Sun is near but not on the MC.

meta.ephemeris: astronomy-engine (Don Cross), tropical zodiac, mean lunar node

mind.howYouDecide: You decide in a cardinal way: you open a path and move, then you correct in motion. mind.howYouAreUnderstood: People understand you as crisp, capable, and hard to stall. You explain by naming the problem, listing the options, and proposing a next step that someone can do today. Then your accuracy gets questioned not because you are wrong, but because you moved faster than trust could keep up, so you end up having to restate the same point more gently.

career.howYouShowUp: People notice speed, responsiveness, and a mind that stays online in public. You ask sharp questions in the meeting, you summarise what everyone is circling around, and you are usually the person who can write the email that ends the confusion. You can also look restless when the pace drops, and you may fill silence with more words than the moment needs. You work best with autonomy over your calendar and direct access to decision-makers, because you get prickly when you have to route everything through layers. career.growthThroughWork: Your growth edge is to build a craft that holds your creativity to a standard even when nobody is watching, and to treat consistency as part of your talent. You can default to working from the head and performing competence, while postponing the boring maintenance that makes a career durable. You also have to watch the part of you that equates intensity with effectiveness, especially around budgets, contracts, and other people’s assets. The steadier path is to make your daily workload clean and repeatable, to ask for definitions before you act, and to let your reputation be built by follow-through, not just by quick brilliance.

Jupiter ruling from the 11th makes home less about isolation and more about being held by a wider web. You host, feed, and protect, and you relax when there is mutual backup. Saturn here makes you serious about what you make. You would rather build one craft you respect than chase quick applause, and you can be reluctant to share work until it meets your standards. Uranus and Neptune add sudden surges of inspiration, followed by long stretches of revision. You alternate between strict structure and strange new angles. Behaviour check: Time how long you wait before showing a draft to anyone, even one trusted person.

The North Node here pulls you toward cleaner systems, better tools, and steadier maintenance, even when you would rather push through on willpower. Saturn ruling from the 5th means your health and workload improve when you treat rest and play as scheduled obligations, not rewards. You do best with routines you can actually repeat. Behaviour check: Pick one daily habit and make it smaller, so you stop breaking promises to yourself.

Chiron here makes partnership a place where old tenderness gets touched fast. You can over-accommodate to keep the bond calm, then feel unseen later. Jupiter ruling from the 11th means you choose lasting partners through friendship, shared community, and mutual protection, not just chemistry. You need allies, not projects. Behaviour check: In your next hard conversation, state one want directly before you explain it.

Mars here meets crisis head-on. You take charge when money is shared, when trust is on the line, or when decisions have consequences, and you hate vague agreements. You can move too fast to regain control, then realise you skipped consent, context, or timing. High stakes can feel clarifying to you. Behaviour check: Before you sign, merge, or confess, wait one full day and reread what you agreed to.

Venus here gives you a love of learning that feels sensual and practical. You prefer teachers and philosophies that improve your actual life, and you can be loyal to a worldview that has proved itself. Travel, study, and publishing can become both pleasure and income. You avoid ideas that feel performative or cruel. Behaviour check: Notice where you nod along to stay polite, then privately disagree and disengage.

Sun, Moon, and Mercury here make you publicly legible. You are the person others look to for naming, framing, and keeping the story coherent, and you feel exposed when you cannot answer quickly. Moon with Mercury can fuse feelings and facts, so your tone reveals more than you intend. Behaviour check: In one meeting, pause before responding and notice how the room adjusts to your silence.

Jupiter here brings real help through friends, patrons, and teams, and you do best when you let people be generous with you. You often end up as the connector who introduces the right people and keeps morale steady. With the Moon ruling from the 10th, your sense of belonging is affected by your public role. Behaviour check: This week, accept an invitation you would normally decline, and watch what it changes.

The South Node here makes solitude feel natural, and you can disappear into your own head without noticing you have gone missing from your life. Sun as ruler in the 10th means private depletion shows up as public strain first, like irritability, fatigue, or losing your spark in front of others. Quiet restores you, but hiding drains you. Behaviour check: Notice whether you cancel plans to rest, or to avoid being seen.

overview.headline: You are built to be recognised for what you know, how fast you connect the dots, and how cleanly you can make a decision in public.
overview.distinctive: What is unusual is how unified your public self is. Your drive to be seen as capable, your day-to-day emotional regulation, and your decision-making all pull toward the same arena, so there is less separation between “who you are” and “what you do” than most people get. This makes you impressive in motion. It also makes you harder to shut off. The central friction is urgency around entanglements: shared money, unequal power, debt, secrets, or intimacy. You move fast there, sometimes faster than the situation is actually clear, and you can feel compelled to take control to calm your nerves. At your best, you turn that intensity into clean boundaries, careful risk, and direct conversations that stop problems from spreading.
overview.temperament: You run earth and cardinal. You are made of practicality, and you use it to start things and set direction. You investigate first and commit second. You ask the extra question, find the missing detail, and then you move. You decide out loud, then tighten the wording after. You draft the email, test the logic, and only then hit send. You act quickly when a situation has consequences, and you prefer a plan you can execute over a theory you can admire. You are also sensitive to competence. You respect people who show their work, and you lose patience when someone keeps it vague. When you are under pressure, you can take on too much simply because you can see what needs doing and you know you could do it.
overview.concentration: You keep steering life toward visible responsibility, even when you tell yourself you want something quieter. You feel most like yourself when there is a real role to occupy, a problem with stakes, and people who are waiting for your answer. You notice that your emotions and your identity both get louder when your work is on the line, and you can read your stress level by how much you keep talking, drafting, messaging, or reorganising information. The quieter places show up when you go missing on purpose. You disappear to think, to recover, or to do the unglamorous maintenance that no one sees, and then you return with a finished position. You also have a private, serious streak around pleasure and creativity. You do not relax easily. You improve a skill through repetition, and you can feel guilty for enjoying yourself unless you can justify it.

foundation.chartThesis: This is a public-life chart that runs on voice, competence, and visibility. Identity, emotional regulation, and decision-making are all routed through the same place: the 10th-house Gemini concentration, led by a domiciled Mercury as chart ruler. The life works best when your professional role is built around translating complexity into clear choices, and it costs you when the same mental gear never turns off.
foundation.centralTension: The chart’s main push-pull is between fast, forceful action around high-stakes entanglements and a protective need to keep relationships and community stable. Mars in Aries in the 8th (domicile, contrary to sect) wants direct control of risk, debt, and shared-resource scenarios, while Jupiter in Cancer in the 11th (exalted, in sect) wants safety through allies, belonging, and mutually supportive networks. When stressed, the tension shows up as moving too quickly on a financial or intimate decision, then trying to smooth it over socially; when integrated, it becomes courageous leadership that still protects long-term trust.
foundation.dominantPattern: A single career-facing engine drives most outcomes: Mercury in Gemini in the 10th (domicile) with Sun and Moon also in Gemini in the 10th. You tend to solve problems by naming them quickly, mapping options, and moving information between people, and you feel exposed when you do not have language for what is happening. A second, steadier pattern supports it: strong dignities (Venus in Taurus, Mars in Aries, Saturn in Capricorn, Jupiter exalted in Cancer) make you effective when you commit to a structure and keep showing up.

sectionGuidance.mind: Pin down the mind’s signature as fast synthesis plus decisive execution under pressure (Moon–Mercury conjunction; Mercury sextile Mars tight), including the specific failure mode of speaking/deciding too quickly when stakes feel high.
sectionGuidance.focus: Give a single integrating aim: align Spirit in the 1st with Fortune in the 12th by choosing identity-led routines that protect quiet time, sleep, and privacy, so public output does not cannibalize recovery.
sectionGuidance.money: Tie money to 9th-house Venus: income and spending shaped by learning, credentials, travel, publishing, and aesthetics, and give one clear rule for preventing Venus-out-of-sect softness from turning into financial drift.
sectionGuidance.triad: Differentiate the three anchors without repeating: Sun as public purpose/recognition, Moon as daily nervous-system needs, and Mercury as the deciding/communicating engine, all in the 10th, so the reader can name which one is driving at a given moment.
sectionGuidance.career: Make career concrete: describe the kind of roles, responsibilities, and public expectations that fit a Mercury-ruled 10th with luminaries there, and how authority is earned through clarity, responsiveness, and visible competence.
sectionGuidance.family: Ground home and origin in Jupiter in the 11th: what “home” requires socially (protective community, chosen family), and how that contrasts with the 12th-house Fortune theme of periodic retreat or hidden burdens.
sectionGuidance.overview: Establish the locomotive feel: a life that moves because you keep initiating, and that stabilizes when you choose one track and let it run long enough to compound (dominant cardinal + locomotive + strong 10th).
sectionGuidance.discoveries: Handle the hard edges without moralizing: Mars contrary to sect in the 8th with tight squares (Mars square Jupiter; Mars square Neptune) as the pattern of risk, urgency, and ambiguity, and what practices reduce collateral damage.
sectionGuidance.superpowers: Name two usable advantages only: (1) social protection and opportunity through Jupiter exalted in the 11th, and (2) long-build creative discipline from Saturn domiciled in the 5th (retrograde) that can outlast trends.
sectionGuidance.relationships: Frame partnership as Jupiter-led: commitment through friendship networks and shared community, plus the specific vulnerability signaled by Chiron in the 7th (what gets poked in one-to-one dynamics and what repair looks like in behavior).

paradoxes.title: Fast mind, high stakes
paradoxes.tension: You can make decisions quickly, speak plainly, and cut through confusion in public. People come to you when time is short and the options are messy. At the same time, when money, trust, or intimacy is on the line, you can move even faster, like urgency proves you are in control. You may commit before every detail is verified, then spend days cleaning up misunderstandings, adjusting terms, or trying to smooth over a hard edge that landed sharper than you intended. You notice it when your speed creates collateral damage.
paradoxes.invitation: Let speed become something you choose, not something that happens to you. Build a pause that is specific: name the risk, name the unknown, and ask one clarifying question before you act, so your courage stays clean and your influence grows.

paradoxes.title: Pleasure that complicates growth
paradoxes.tension: You have refined taste, strong standards, and a genuine ability to enjoy what you have built. You invest in learning, travel, and experiences that widen your world, and you can justify the expense easily because it is “good for you.” Yet the help you get from pleasure is not always steady. Sometimes comfort becomes the thing that dilutes momentum. You may over-give, over-host, or over-upgrade, then feel quietly resentful when the return is not equal. You recognise it when your budget and your values stop matching.
paradoxes.invitation: Keep pleasure, but make it accountable to what you are trying to build. Put a clear container around generosity and upgrades, so you can say yes without backtracking later. When enjoyment is planned, it stops competing with your long-term choices.

paradoxes.title: Public voice, private fortune
paradoxes.tension: You are built to be seen doing competent work. You think out loud, you organise information in real time, and your identity is tangled up with being useful in public. And yet, a lot of what shapes your material situation happens off-stage. You can have periods where unseen obligations, burnout, or a private worry eats your energy while you still look fine from the outside. You may also receive quiet support from behind the scenes that you do not talk about. You notice it when rest becomes non-negotiable after you have already overextended.
paradoxes.invitation: Treat privacy as a resource, not a luxury. Protect time alone the way you protect appointments. When you build recovery into the week, you stop paying for visibility with your body, and you get to choose how much of yourself you reveal.

superpower.text: You build luck through people, not through force. You introduce the right two people, make the right ask, or show up when someone else needs backup, and doors open in ways that feel almost unfair. You can check this by noticing how often your best opportunities arrive through a friend, a team, or a patron rather than a cold application. You are also good at setting a tone of emotional safety in groups, so others tell you what is really going on. When you overdo it, you become the unofficial buffer for everyone’s stress and you wonder why you are tired after “just socialising.”

growingEdge.text: You are pulled toward a life where your work is consistently useful, even when it is not glamorous and even when nobody applauds. You can check this by how much resistance you feel to routines that make your days run better. You can be excellent at big pushes and public problem-solving, then oddly avoid the small daily systems that would protect your body and your focus. The growth is learning to be a steady worker inside your own life. That includes letting tasks be “good enough,” delegating, and allowing learning curves in practical skills. You become harder to derail when your week has structure.

chronicPattern.text: When the stakes feel shared, private, or financially tangled, you move fast and you want control. You can check this by how quickly your body goes into “solve it now” mode around debt, shared accounts, intimacy, secrecy, or crisis. You push for decisions, press for clarity, and take the lead even when nobody asked you to. The trouble is that urgency can make you skip verification, or act on a story that is not fully true yet. Later, you may spend energy smoothing the social fallout or explaining a choice you made under pressure. This pattern does not go away. It gets managed.

relationships.howYouLove: You love with a steady, practical loyalty, and you relax when life together feels protected by real people and real plans, not just chemistry. You give by showing up, feeding what you’re building, and making introductions that actually help. You are more affectionate when you respect someone’s competence and kindness, and when they treat your friends and community like they matter. You say you want excitement and independence, but what actually attracts you is emotional maturity, follow-through, and a person who can be warm without being needy. You bond through frequent conversation, quick check-ins, and shared language for what is happening, and you feel shut out when you have to guess where you stand.
relationships.theChallenge: You have a recurring pattern of moving fast when the stakes are high, then realising you agreed to more intensity than you can sustainably hold. In intimacy, urgency can look like honesty, so you push for clarity, decisions, or merging before the situation is fully named. When fear shows up, you can default to control around shared money, shared obligations, or sexual closeness, and then feel frustrated that the relationship is no longer simple. You also tend to talk through feelings as if they are problems to solve, which works until your partner wants presence instead of solutions. In your history, the turning point is often the same: one unclear promise, one blurred boundary, or one secret worry that grows because it stayed unspoken.

relationships.whatPartnershipAsks: Partnership asks you to choose bonds that are good for your nervous system, not just good on paper. You are built to thrive in relationships that sit inside a wider net of support, where friendship and community keep the connection breathable. You grow when you let trust be cumulative, and when you allow time to prove what someone does under pressure. You also develop intimacy by stating your needs early, plainly, and without testing. You are here to practice being direct without escalating, and to let repair be an everyday skill, not a crisis event.

venus_trine_saturn.growth: Treating the ease as a resource to be invested rather than a comfort to rest in.
venus_trine_saturn.dynamic: Venus and Saturn. Venus is attraction, pleasure, taste, and the capacity to draw people in. Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Two functions in signs of the same element flow into each other without resistance. What they do together comes easily, often so easily that it goes unnoticed and undervalued.
venus_trine_saturn.tension: Complacency. The gift is taken for granted, left undeveloped, or used as an excuse to avoid harder things.
venus_trine_saturn.behavior: Effortless talent. The two functions combine naturally and reliably.

Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Two functions in signs that share a mode but not an element push against each other. mars_square_jupiter.tension: Recurring conflict, frustration, and the sense of being pulled two ways at once.
mars_square_jupiter.behavior: Hard-won competence. The friction has been turned into a driving engine.

moon_conjunction_mercury.growth: Learning to feel which of the two is speaking, and to give each its turn.
moon_conjunction_mercury.dynamic: Moon and Mercury. The Moon is the body, the habits, and what makes someone feel safe. Mercury is how a person thinks, learns, decides and makes themselves understood. Two functions occupy the same place and act as one. Neither can be used without engaging the other, so their natures blend, for better or worse depending on how compatible they are.
moon_conjunction_mercury.tension: The two cannot be separated, so the difficulty of one contaminates the other and there is no clean way to use either alone.
moon_conjunction_mercury.behavior: The two work as a single combined strength, each amplifying the other.

jupiter_opposition_saturn.growth: Owning both ends instead of projecting one, and finding the position between them.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.dynamic: Jupiter and Saturn. Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Two functions in opposite signs pull in opposite directions and can see each other clearly. The tension is external and relational: it tends to play out between the person and someone else, or as a swing between two extremes.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.tension: Polarisation. The person identifies with one side and meets the other in someone else, usually as conflict.
jupiter_opposition_saturn.behavior: Balance and perspective. Each side tempers the other and the person can hold both.

personalPlanets.mars: Mars is drive, assertion, and the capacity to cut through and go after something. Aries acts first, directly and fast, and sorts things out afterward. The 8th is shared resources, loss, inheritance, and what is not one's own.

personalPlanets.venus: Venus is attraction, pleasure, taste, and the capacity to draw people in. Taurus is steady, sensual, slow to start and slower to stop. The 9th is the far world: belief, higher learning, travel, and meaning.
personalPlanets.chiron: Chiron marks a wound that becomes a source of skill and understanding for others. Pisces feels everything, blurs boundaries, and gives more than it keeps. The 7th is the other: partners, spouses, open rivals, and one-to-one bonds.
personalPlanets.saturn: Saturn is structure, limit, duration, and the discipline that makes things last. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.uranus: Uranus is disruption, independence, and the sudden break from what was expected. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.jupiter: Jupiter is expansion, confidence, generosity, and the sense that more is possible. Cancer protects, remembers, and holds close what it cares about. The 11th is allies, friends, groups, and hopes shared with others.
personalPlanets.mercury: Mercury is how a person thinks, learns, decides and makes themselves understood. Gemini is quick, curious, verbal, and interested in everything at once. The 10th is vocation, reputation, and what one is known for doing.
personalPlanets.neptune: Neptune is dissolution, longing, imagination, and the blurring of hard edges. Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, and plays the long game. The 5th is pleasure, creativity, children, and what one does for its own sake.
personalPlanets.north_node: The North Node is the direction of growth: unfamiliar, uncomfortable, and worth it. Aquarius stands apart, thinks in systems, and cares about the group. The 6th is work, routine, health, and what must be maintained.
personalPlanets.south_node: The South Node is the default: what comes easily and what gets overused. Leo is warm, proud, generous, and needs to be seen doing it. The 12th is what is hidden: solitude, sorrow, secrets, and self-undoing.
